caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a rectangular wooden case, rendered primarily in reddish-brown tones that suggest polished wood grain. The clock has a broad, square base with a raised panel design, and a central vertical trunk segment featuring a door with a subtly arched panel. Above the trunk is an ornate, upper cabinet housing the clock face. The arched clock face is primarily cream-colored with black hour markers and hands, and includes a blue and white painted arch at the top, displaying a human face half in shadow, possibly representing a moon phase feature. The clock is topped by an elaborate, scrolled pediment with three pointed finials, the central one being a brass-colored bird figure with spread wings, flanked by round ornaments. The background is a plain, off-white color with some visible smudges and yellowish discoloration near the edges. The perspective and rendering style create a realistic depiction of the grandfather clock with attention to the details of the woodwork and clock mechanics.
title: Grandfather's Clock
